scope: Integrate settled original MOVE ownership into room-command and exit execution guards.
finding: The previous completed-leg ADOPT restored metadata, but BuildingOperationStep still classified current WAIT as neither owned MOVE nor hold and could refuse continuation for an already-started actor. An adoption-only patch was not complete executor integration.
implementation: Add read-only CHECK mode to BuildingActorMotion using the same current operation/actor/episode/route/native proof and settled-leg exception as ADOPT. CHECK exits after proof and before any publication or job metadata writes. Room-command and exit predicates invoke it only for WAIT. Active-move ownership remains actual MOVE-only; no arbitrary WAIT, native command, visit credit, request age or deadline change.
cost: No new worker, scan or replay queue. WAIT guards now execute existing operation/route/native proof; they may repeat in a callback and their cost is unmeasured. Do not describe the added predicate cost as zero or claim performance budget compliance.
limits: Code integration, not live tactical acceptance. Physical room/exit flow, normal/HC/JIP, replay/owner-ready transport and 5%median/10%p95 budget remain unverified/incomplete. Audits paused; whole goal active/incomplete; no percentage claim.
